test_assign: test the DataFrame.assign method adds a new column computed from existing columns
test_assign_multiple: test the DataFrame.assign method adds multiple new columns at once
test_assign_order: test the DataFrame.assign method preserves keyword argument order for column ordering
test_assign_bad: test the DataFrame.assign method raises TypeError for positional args and AttributeError for missing columns
test_assign_dependent: test the DataFrame.assign method allows later columns to reference earlier assigned columns via lambda
